headline: Brian Steele Claims OTF Jam is Serial Killer: 'How Dare FBI Put Him on Stand to Lie'
body: Trap Lore Ross reports Brian Steele accused OTF Jam of being a serial killer, stating the FBI 'put him on the stand to lie.' The post, published September 8, 2026, shows Steele criticizing the FBI's handling of the case. With 951 likes and 32 comments, the claim has sparked debate about legal credibility in hip-hop circles.
